package.name: sic_slam_gui
package.description: InfoLabel: a minimal gz-gui plugin showing one live gz-transport StringMsg value in a small, transparent, corner-anchored rectangle -- built because no shipped gz-gui8 plugin does a plain corner readout (TopicEcho is a scrollable debug console, not a label; confirmed by checking the actual installed plugin set, not guessed). Used by sic_slam_cave_water.world for the current-speed/turbidity overlays.
